doc_title: Tigo TS4-A-2F (Fire Safety for 2 modules) Data Sheet - EN v2.9
notes: Re-keyed to real product TS4-A-2O dual-module optimizer (equipment-db id tigo-ts4-a-2o). Earlier worker mismatched to TS4-A-2F fire-safety part. Source is the Tigo TS4-A product/datasheet family page. NAMING MISMATCH: Tigo has NO product called 'TS4-A-2'. The TS4-A lineup is TS4-A-O (optimization), TS4-A-S (safety+monitoring), TS4-A-M (monitoring), TS4-A-F (fire safety, 1 module), TS4-A-2F (fire safety, 2 modules). Best match for the '-2' id is TS4-A-2F (one unit covering 2 modules). Landing page + direct Webflow-CDN PDF both verified (curl 200 application/pdf, 3.0MB; WebFetch confirmed page title 'Datasheet: TS4-A-2F (Fire Safety for 2 modules) v2.9'). NOTE: TS4-A-2F is a rapid-shutdown/fire-safety MLPE, NOT a power optimizer -- if the intended product was truly an optimizer, the correct Tigo optimizer is TS4-A-O (tigo-ts4-a-o above); confirm intent with Ray before wiring.
